traps.why: Where run 20260909-072307's 12 "dated" events came from, on a site with zero dated listings: (a) /events blurbs, 3 records - "Trivia Taco night" 2026-09-29 with FREQ=MONTHLY;BYDAY=-1TU (the cancelled last-Tuesday exception read as the rule), "Queeraoke" 2026-09-09 20:30 WEEKLY;WE (fine), and this kept record "Dolly and the DJ" 2026-09-12T21:00Z-2026-09-13T01:00Z = Saturday 14:00-18:00 local with FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=SA, description "come hang with the friendly bears 2-6pm" and isBearEvent true: title and weekday from the Saturday blurb, time and description from the Sunday blurb, bear verdict earned by the Sunday blurb's words - a chimera that puts a drag/DJ night on the bear calendar and erases the actual Sunday bear social; (b) the 2026-09-07 homepage cache, 2 records - "BRUNCH 11-2pm" (kept, see homepage-sunday-brunch-11-2pm) and a second Queeraoke that dedup folded into (a)'s ("1 duplicate removed"); (c) /mothly-events flyers, 6 records - EXPOSED 2026-09-11, SHOWTUNES 2026-10-01, Drink & Draw 2026-09-29, GAY BINGO 2026-09-24 (4TH only), RAT CITY HONKY TONK 2026-10-02, CHOPPER 'N' FRIENDS 2026-09-19 (kept) - each a legitimate monthly rule with its next occurrence materialized, GAME ON! missed; (d) an off-site ticketleap page, 1 record - "Queer Art Market" 2025-03-22 (see ticketleap-queer-art-market-2025). Total 3+2+6+1 = 12 = the run's totalEvents. The dates are all rule arithmetic from undated text; none is a listed instance. This trap is the fused Saturday record specifically: it must not exist. The two blurbs are documented separately as dolly-and-the-dj and south-seattle-bear-social-sunday.
